design_fields.q1_rationale: The study does not use ILSA student microdata and instead analyzes Google Trends data, making plausible values handling not applicable.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study does not use ILSA student microdata and therefore does not apply ILSA sampling or replicate weights.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not analyze student-level survey data where schools are the sampling unit, as it focuses on Google Trends data.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study does not mention any validation strategies such as cross-validation or external validation, nor does it provide any information on validation.
